From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed rotating availability pattern for ClearWave deep dive

Hi Sam / Clara —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

- Recap: ClearWave is evaluating inference routing + cost controls for clinical-document summarization (3 customer-facing apps, ~20M tokens/month estimated). Security, predictable latency, and a plan for regional coverage were top priorities.
- Next meeting: technical deep dive (45–60m) with engineering + security (you mentioned likely participants on your side: Clara + infrastructure lead).

To make scheduling straightforward across your EMEA + APAC users, we sketched a rotating slot pattern that spreads anchor windows across US / EU / APAC over a 3-week cycle so the same weekday occasionally lands in each region’s working hours. Attached is a small availability grid (availability-grid-v3.xlsx) and the pattern below: 

Proposed 3-week rotating pattern (simple, consistent):
- Week A (anchor = US mornings): Mon/Wed 09:00–10:00 PT (US morning slot)
- Week B (anchor = EU afternoons): Tue/Thu 15:00–16:00 CET (EU afternoon slot)
- Week C (anchor = APAC evenings): Wed/Fri 18:00–19:00 IST / 21:30–22:30 AEST (APAC-friendly slot)

Notes on the pattern:
- Each calendar event is a recurring series with a 3-week rotation rule; we keep the day-of-week consistent for continuity but slide the region focus. That minimizes churn for both teams while giving equal live-window coverage.
- We can set up three recurring calendar invites and mark who should be on each rotation (engineering, product, and security).
- If ClearWave prefers a different anchor cadence (e.g., daily short office hours), we can adapt — this is a starting scaffold.

Can you confirm who from ClearWave will join the technical deep dive and three preferred 45–60m slots in the next two weeks? If helpful I can create tentative calendar invites for the proposed Week A/B/C events and share a link.

Attaching availability-grid-v3.xlsx with our suggested timebands.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attendees (probable): Clara Soto (Infra lead), Rajiv Menon (SRE, APAC), and me (Product). Legal will want to quick-read the MPA but that can happen in parallel.

Preferred windows in next 2 weeks (our timezone / UTC offsets included):
- Tue Jun 3, 14:00–15:00 UTC (works for EU / US overlap)
